messages:
julia - CS: FYI customer 'FinServe' hitting intermittent 504s on /v1/generate since 11:20 PST. We have a P1 escalation — SLA windows tomorrow. Need engineering ownership + ETA.

amir - Eng SRE: Can you paste a sample request id and a snippet of the 504s?

julia - CS: request ids: rQ-7f1a3, rQ-7f1a9. Logs show upstream timeout at routing layer: "upstream request timed out after 10s". Attaching logs to the ticket.

diane - Eng Runtime: tagging in — sounds like the request routing fallback might be causing retries and hitting a timeout. Any recent changes to routing or model variants?

liam - Eng Platform: we rolled the routing policy change to canary at 11:10 (PR #2345). Canary at 10% traffic. I can roll back if needed but need a heads up.

amir - Eng SRE: If canary is the cause, rollback would reduce risk. What's the process time?

liam - Eng Platform: rollback is ~20-30m including smoke tests. Command is:
```
/deploy rollback --service=routing --target=stable --tag=pr-2345
```
I'll queue it if eng-runtime confirms.

diane - Eng Runtime: confirmable correlation: the 504s line up with canary exposure and retries. I can test a hotfix to reduce retry window and increase timeout for fallback path. If that works we avoid rollback. I need ~45m to validate then push.

julia - CS: Customer is asking for an ETA and workaround. They can route traffic to a degraded model variant but need instructions. Sophie, can you coordinate the customer-facing workaround?

sophie - Solutions: Yep. I can provide them with a failover snippet to point at the stable model:
```json
{ "model": "stable-embed-v1", "endpoint": "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" }
```
I'll send it and request they shift 100% traffic temporarily.

amir - Eng SRE: For internal SLAs — if rollback + smoke takes 30m, hotfix takes 45m to validate. Recommend rollback for fastest mitigation unless runtime says hotfix is trivial.

diane - Eng Runtime: hotfix is not trivial on the canary infra; complex cache interactions. Accept rollback as short-term mitigation. I'll own post-rollback verification and a follow-up RCA.

liam - Eng Platform: rolling back now. Starting at 11:32 PST. Will post progress. deploy-bot: please run canary-smoke after rollback.

deploy-bot: roll request received for service=routing, target=stable, tag=pr-2345. Initiating rollback pipeline.

liam - Eng Platform: rollback complete at 11:45 PST. Canary traffic drained. Smoke tests passing (3/3).

amir - Eng SRE: Observability — error rate has dropped to baseline for FinServe. I'm monitoring logs; will keep watch for 1h.

julia - CS: Passing update to customer: rollback done, error rate down. They asked for formal ETA on full resolution — Diane, can you estimate RCA + permanent fix timeline?

diane - Eng Runtime: RCA in progress — suspected routing policy mismatch. I'll have an initial RCA draft + remediation plan by EOD today; permanent fix and tests targeted for next sprint (2 weeks). I'll create a follow-up ticket and assign owners.

sophie - Solutions: Customer confirmed reduced errors after rollback, appreciates quick response. They've accepted the temporary failover.

julia - CS: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Diane: RCA + ticket (due EOD) (2) Diane+Liam: post-rollback verification (in progress) (3) Amir: monitor for 1h (in progress) (4) Sophie: confirm customer scheduling for next-week sync. I'll update the escalation thread once RCA ticket is ready. :thumbsup:
